source.description: Reviewed handmade raster felt-tip-marker process contact sheet.
source.notes: One overlapping pair of face-free flip-flops; no feet, beach scene, lettering, labels, arrows, UI, signatures, watermarks, sticker edge, badge frame, or decorative border.

process_strategy: Eight cumulative panels move from two sparse sole envelopes and strap routes to stable overlapping sandals, six strap branches, six sole bands, complete ink and color decisions, and a finishing-only marker pass.

progression_contract.blank_page_test: A beginner can copy Panel 1 in under two minutes using two open sole envelopes, two center axes, two toe-post dots, six open strap routes, six band ticks, and one broken shadow route.

anchor_map.early_mark: Two long open sole envelopes on crossing diagonal axes
anchor_map.becomes: One rear-left teal flip-flop and one front-right coral flip-flop
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: The coral sole overlaps only the lower-right edge of the teal sole and both keep their original tilt, toe direction, and scale.
anchor_map.construction_note: Open envelopes in Panel 1; complete sole contours begin in Panel 2.

anchor_map.early_mark: One toe-post dot and three open Y routes on each sole
anchor_map.becomes: Two Y-shaped straps with exactly three branches each
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: Each center branch meets its fixed toe post and both side branches attach to the same two sole-edge ticks throughout.
anchor_map.construction_note: Dots and open routes only until Panel 3.

anchor_map.early_mark: Three curved band ticks across each sole
anchor_map.becomes: Exactly three curved color bands on each flip-flop
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: All six bands stay perpendicular to their own sole axis and stop at the reserved strap footprints.

final_elements.name: two-sole strap band and shadow construction guides
final_elements.description: Two open sole envelopes, two axes, two toe-post dots, six open strap routes, six band ticks, and one broken shadow route.

final_elements.name: two overlapping flip-flop sole silhouettes
final_elements.description: One rear-left sole and one front-right sole with thick rounded edges and a fixed small overlap.

final_elements.name: two Y straps with six fixed branches
final_elements.description: One Y-shaped strap on each sole, exactly three branches per sandal, anchored to the toe post and side edges.

final_elements.name: six sole bands and edge seams
final_elements.description: Exactly three curved bands on each sole plus one simple edge seam around each sandal.

final_elements.name: four highlights tread notches and broken shadow
final_elements.description: Two open-paper strap highlights per sandal, small outer-edge tread notches, and one broken navy shadow.

final_elements.name: black marker and complete coral teal yellow aqua and navy color map
final_elements.description: Thick imperfect black outlines with coral and teal soles, golden-yellow and pale-aqua bands, and a navy shadow.

final_elements.name: directional marker texture and small edge accents
final_elements.description: Visible marker streaks, clarified strap overlap accents, and small established tread and shadow refinements.

overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: The rear teal sole edge, seam, bands, and shadow stop at the reserved front coral sole silhouette.

overlap_reservations.foreground_element: two Y straps with six fixed branches
overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: All six decorative band lines stop at the reserved strap footprints and never run through a strap.

rejection_checks: Reject a detailed first panel, a drifting sole overlap, or a toe post or strap branch that changes attachment after appearing.
Reject missing or extra sandals, strap branches, sole bands, highlights, or a stripe that runs through a reserved strap footprint.
Reject a final that introduces a contour, band, color region, flower, foot, sand, beach prop, face, word, logo, sticker edge, or badge frame absent earlier.
Reject vector-like fills, glossy poster rendering, repeated faint-to-dark tracings, labels, arrows, text, signatures, or watermarks.
